summary: Jonathan M. Kennedy, 40, of Fayetteville, Arkansas, died after his kayak overturned in Pine Creek Rapid on the Arkansas River; nearby kayakers attempted to rescue him but were unsuccessful; he was pulled from the river ~1 mile south of the rapid and Chaffee County EMS administered CPR but could not revive him; pronounced dead at the scene
notes: Mountain Mail 2014 season roundup parent-opened this run; fifth accident, 'July 11'.
